title: Radiation-tolerant DDR4 memory chip DDR4T04G72
supports: Teledyne e2v DDR4T04G72 is a 4 GB multichip package, 64 data + 8 ECC bits, SEL >60 MeV.cm2/mg, -55 to 125 C, up to NASA Level 1. 2020 part is 4 GB; an 8 GB DDR4T08G72 appears only in later (2025) listings (via search snippet)

title: Micron Advances Made-in-America Memory with Manufacturing Expansion
supports: 1-alpha DRAM manufacturing started at Manassas VA on 2026-05-22; qualified 1-alpha production expected by end-2026; >$2B expansion will quadruple DDR4 wafer supply for long-lifecycle DDR4/LP4 (auto, defense/aerospace, industrial, networking, medical) (via search snippet)
